results.text: Comparison of sacubitril/valsartan with olmesartan for hypertension: A meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials. The efficacy of sacubitril/valsartan versus olmesartan remains controversial for the control of hypertension. We conduct a systematic review and meta-analysis to explore the influence of sacubitril/valsartan versus olmesartan on the control of hypertension.
